title: GRFP Scorer: rubric-based formative feedback for NSF Graduate Research Fellowship statements
description: A desktop application and command-line tools that score a draft NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program statement against a ten-principle writing rubric, cite the sentence each sub-score rests on, and propose the highest-value revisions. Supports the Claude API (user-supplied key), a local Ollama model, or an offline lexical mode. Scores describe rubric fit only and are not predictions of fellowship outcomes.
